shortDescription: Reusable action card for membership entry points.
fullDescription: Displays a large clickable membership action with a circular icon, emphasized title, and optional muted surface styling. It is designed for dashboard-style launch sections where views need consistent action tiles for creating memberships, resuming pending work, or similar flows.

Renders the main membership management landing view with a branded top bar, two primary action cards for starting a new membership or opening pending processes, and a centered search section for locating existing member profiles by name, phone, email, or membership number. The screen composes the reusable membership action card together with shared button, separator, and input-group components.
